A blinding beam of light from the sky shining down on a man (Saul) who has fallen backward onto a dusty road, shielding his eyes with his arm. In the background, two travelling companions stand frozen in confusion, holding staffs.

A rooftop scene with a man (Peter) looking up in shock as a large white sheet, tied at its four corners, descends from the clouds. Inside the sheet are various animals, including cows, pigs, snakes, and birds.

A map of the eastern Mediterranean Sea detailing Paul's First Missionary Journey. Red arrows show the route starting from Antioch in Syria, sailing to the island of Cyprus (Salamis to Paphos), then sailing north to Perga in Pamphylia. From there, inland arrows go to Antioch in Pisidia, Iconium, Lystra, and Derbe, before tracing the same path back to the coast and sailing straight back to Antioch in Syria.
